reconciliations.detail: The Q+P and Q+H retunes ran retune_run.py as of commit 560a4e382. The Q+A and Q+O retunes ran an earlier copy. The differences are refactors, and the replay and retune code are unchanged. Krishna's check: arm_scoring at the committed code reproduces 358 and 389.
reconciliations.title: Retune driver differs by arm
